written_late_reason: The contract's own freeze_rule states 'Its sha256 is recorded in freeze_receipt.json and is re-hashed by the measurement task, which HALTS if the digest differs.' TASK-20260802-80f5e9 froze the contract but never wrote that file, so the declared halt mechanism referenced a receipt that did not exist. Recorded as a defect of the freezing task in CORR-20260803-a1c41e. This receipt is written by the BATCH-038 opening Coordinator task from the committed specification as it stands; it is NOT a claim that the receipt existed at freeze time.
digest_provenance: Computed by the BATCH-038 opening task over the committed bytes of specification.yaml on branch claude/implementation-p9dqz3. No datum, no measurement, and no edit to the specification are implied or performed.
halt_rule: The measurement task re-hashes specification.yaml and HALTS if the digest differs from specification_sha256 above. A differing digest means the frozen contract changed and the run is void.
supersession_receipt_note: EXP-SMTH-71b1b0 declares that EXP-SMTH-4403c4 'is left unedited with its sha256 80b75c415b3456772acf09901a67ea0644d984dae84f8ad01946fc8afeb5b801 standing'. Two checks fail: (1) experiments/EXP-SMTH-4403c4/specification.yaml is absent from the working tree; (2) the file has exactly one version in the entire git history, at commit f846c8dd, whose sha256 is 664e37a3752b984f6b213dde21c9d7c26e891708325185c785f36c5d6462eb6f. The declared digest matches no committed version. Recorded in CORR-20260803-a1c41e. This does NOT block the measurement: the contract states its measured quantity directly rather than by reference to the superseded contract.

authorization.note: The specification is frozen and is NOT edited to flip execution_authorized. Authorization is an external, later, committed fact carried by DEC-20260803-155a86 and by this receipt, exactly as corrections supersede rather than overwrite. A reviewer who reads the freeze_rule as requiring a superseding contract instead should say so and the batch will be re-opened against a new contract id.
